description: Use when someone has quality control (QC) results for a lab or point-of-care test and wants to know whether they break Westgard rules or how they look on a Levey-Jennings chart (e.g. 'do these control values fail any Westgard rules?', 'check my QC: mean 5.0, SD 0.1, values ...', 'is this a 2-2s or 4-1s violation?'). Takes control values in run order plus the target mean and SD (or computes them from the values if the user asks) and evaluates 1-2s (warning), 1-3s, 2-2s, R-4s, 4-1s and 10x. Returns z-scores, the rule hits for each point and a plain summary, and draws a Levey-Jennings chart in ChatGPT and Claude. Up to 500 values. QC statistics only: not a clinical interpretation of any patient result.

compute_from_values.description: True only if the user asks to compute the mean and SD from the values.

mean.description: Target mean for this control lot and level.

sd.description: Target SD for this control lot and level.

values.description: Control values in run order, oldest first.

name: check_qc_westgard
title: Check lab QC values against Westgard rules
